Question: If point \(P\) is equidistant from the two sides of \(\angle AOB\), must \(P\) lie on the angle bisector (\(P\) lies inside the angle)?

Choices.A: Yes, it must lie on the angle bisector
Choices.B: Not necessarily; it also depends on the distance from \(P\) to the vertex \(O\)
Choices.C: Not necessarily; it lies on the angle bisector only when \(\angle AOB\) is a right angle
Choices.D: No, it definitely does not lie on the angle bisector

Solution: A point inside an angle that is equidistant from its two sides lies on the angle bisector. This is the angle bisector criterion.
